name: Amelia Bauer
source:
A friendly and energetic girl who loves sports, she is very popular at the school and has excellent athletic skills.

She has earned the nickname “Princess General of Gelavri,” which is why she was the first target of Iriya's investigation.

She has the poor fate of always being unwittingly caught up in Iriya's espionage activities.
